title: Microscopic image of a tangled fibrous material
visual_facts: A grayscale electron-microscope image shows a dense mesh of thin fibers.
The fibers cross and overlap in many directions, leaving irregular dark gaps.
A scale bar and instrument settings are printed along the bottom edge.
spatial_relations: The fibers form an interwoven network across the whole image.
uncertainties: The material and its source are not identified in the image.
The small scale-bar tick labels are not legible.
